description:
A large eight-legged Phase Spider that can shift between planes. The original template records no carried items or wealth. In the 2-by-1 combat-tile footprint it crouches on eight legs in ready, then rears its front body, strikes to screen right with its front pair, and opens its mandibles while the other six legs support its abdomen.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT - READY:
Use case: new-transparent-game-sprite
Asset type: exactly one READY frame for MON8CHA.DAX:116/default, exported as a 128x128 transparent combat sprite.
Create ONE anatomically clear Phase Spider facing screen right. Its bulbous abdomen is image-left; the cephalothorax, clustered amber eyes, short pedipalps and mostly closed fangs are image-right. It has EIGHT and only eight walking legs: four leg roots on the far side and four on the near side, all attached to the cephalothorax, with eight separate planted pointed tips. At combat size, every leg must trace visibly through a knee to its own tip. Use broad, bold leg shapes and transparent gaps between them; no overlapping bundle of thin legs and no extra walking pair.
This is a LOW CRAWLING spider that sits on all eight legs in a 2-combat-square-wide by 1-square-high footprint. Compose its visible silhouette at least 1.8 times wider than tall. In the future 128x128 export, plan approximately x=7..120 and y=64..122, with eight leg tips near the same ground zone and room for a short rightward bite. Keep the leg knees and upper arcs LOW, no high vaulted legs above the abdomen, no upright rearing. Use a slightly elevated three-quarter view so far and near legs remain distinguishable and the right-facing mouth is visible. The abdomen stays behind the head; ready fangs are poised but not yet striking.
Use crisp bold fantasy pixel-art clusters that remain readable at 128 pixels: warm russet-brown and charcoal chitin, muted violet iridescent abdomen bands, pale tan joint accents, small amber eyes. Keep the body and all eight feet entirely within a transparent 128x128 canvas with margin. No large glow, web, floor, scenery, shadow, other creatures, armor, weapons, labels, border or motion effect. ONE spider, ONE frame, no duplicate, sheet or diptych.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT - ACTION:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: exactly ONE ACTION frame for MON8CHA.DAX:116/default, final 128x128 transparent combat PNG.
Input Image 1 is the first newly generated REARING ACTION DRAFT and is the edit target for its attacking pose: preserve its lifted front cephalothorax, two raised front walking legs striking screen right, wide-open mandibles, and russet/charcoal/violet pixel-art design. Input Image 2 is the checked-in 128x128 READY sprite and is the exact anatomy, scale and grounded-leg reference for this same single spider. Neither is original game art.
Fix the first action draft's missing-leg problem. Show exactly EIGHT walking legs with clearly traceable joints: a pair of raised attacking forelegs reaching SCREEN RIGHT (one above the other) PLUS THREE additional pairs of supporting walking legs, SIX planted support feet in total. In the current draft there are not enough supporting legs; add the missing middle pair so that all six support feet and both raised attack tips are visible and separated. The short pedipalps beside the mouth do not count as legs. Keep every leg attached to the cephalothorax and make the supporting feet align with the accepted ready sprite. Do not invent another spider or a detached leg.
Preserve the ready sprite's full-sized abdomen in the same image-left location and keep its rear body and six support contacts rooted; do not slide or resize the spider. The front cephalothorax rears upward within the saved 2-wide by 1-high combat footprint, while the two anterior walking legs lift off the ground and strike to the right. The mandibles/chelicerae gape wide with both fangs visible under the raised head. This must clearly read as an attack at native 128px size. Keep continuous anatomy across the abdomen-thorax join. Aim for all final visible pixels within x=7..122, y=60..123, with transparent margin.
ONE full-body action sprite of ONE spider only, not a sheet or duplicate. No web, beam, glow, armor, scenery, ground shadow, label, border, black box or motion streak. Genuine transparent alpha.
